answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the marble graph and each risks its bond. Because the wander release is recorded with every signature, the onyx audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 5 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. The deposit is 32 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
